brief:
An-Najah National University improved its position in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027, moving into the 701–800 band globally, the Ma'an news agency reported. The Palestinian institution maintained its leading rank among universities in the Palestinian territories.

The advancement reflects the university's continued academic performance in the annual assessment by Times Higher Education, which evaluates institutions worldwide across research, teaching, and international reputation metrics.
title: An-Najah University advances to global ranking 701–800 in Times Higher Education 2027
